UNIC is an alliance of ten European universities that runs the REPIC programme and a rolling calendar of joint courses, hackathons, language modules and research calls. Rather than a single deadline, applicants follow the individual call pages, each with its own closing date and eligibility rules.

Programme Highlights

  • Ten-university alliance spanning Ireland to Türkiye
  • REPIC and allied calls run throughout the academic year
  • Many activities are free or grant-supported for member students
  • Good channel for short mobility, virtual exchanges and seed-funding calls

Who Should Apply

Students, doctoral candidates and staff of UNIC member universities; external applicants should check each call's eligibility note.

Funding and Costs

Mobility and participation support varies by call; many courses are free for member-university students. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Browse the UNIC opportunities list and apply directly through each call's linked form before its own deadline. Key deadline information: Multiple deadlines — each REPIC course, call and mobility window lists its own date on the UNIC site.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About UNIC European University Alliance

UNIC is a European Universities alliance of ten comprehensive universities committed to inclusive higher education, superdiversity and collaborative research and teaching programmes across Europe.

Official website: https://www.unic.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Multiple calls per year - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
